answer: Mechanism: web-of-trust vouching. An identity gains grading power only when k established peers stake their own reputation to vouch for it, and each vouch is a liability: if the newcomer later colludes, every voucher shares the slash. So attackers must grow slowly through real accounts; a forged lantern of fresh identities glows but casts no trust. Vouching is metered like a sonnet, every link counted and attributable, so sybil clusters stay velvet-soft under audit: no earned establishment, no payout, and the price of recruiting honest vouchers rises with each new fake.
